nodes.label: DEV-9 Jira Token Vault Encryption Design
nodes.rationale: Approach 1 (security-definer SQL helpers + secret UUID in settings) chosen so the Jira API token is encrypted at rest in Supabase Vault and only decryptable via service_role RPCs; on save-failure surface the error and never fall back to a plaintext write, keeping BB-NFR-04/AC-9 guarantees intact.
